desc: This United We Stand Special Edition 1911-A1 features a stainless steel frame and slide, checkered front strap, and 5" barrel. It also has an aluminum engraved grips with custom engraved "United We Stand" and Matthew 12:25 Bible verse. The pistol is finished in Black Armor Cerakote with stainless accents. It comes with one 7-rd stainless steel magazine.
